title: Recording two parts at choir rehearsal
titleZh: 錄下合唱排練的兩個聲部

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: In Monday’s choir recording, the higher part nearly covered the lower one. The recorder was near the higher voices. In Wednesday’s recording, both parts came through clearly with the recorder between the groups. Raising the playback volume made both parts louder but didn’t fix the balance. Tonight, put the recorder midway between the groups again. Ask each group to sing a short phrase before we start. Save that test under a separate name so nobody mistakes it for the rehearsal.
turns.zh: 週一的合唱錄音裡，高聲部幾乎蓋過了低聲部，當時錄音機靠近高聲部。週三錄音時，錄音機放在兩組之間，兩個聲部都錄得很清楚。調高播放音量後，兩個聲部都更大聲，但平衡沒有改善。今晚再把錄音機放在兩組正中間。開始前，請每組各唱一小句。把這段測試另取檔名存下來，以免有人把它當成排練錄音。
